national_news.title: Rashtriya Sankalp Samaroh Organized Under Nasha Mukt Yuva Abhiyan
bullets: The Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports organized the Rashtriya Sankalp Samaroh across 1,067 locations nationwide to eradicate drug abuse among youth.
The event is part of the 'Nasha Mukt Yuva for Viksit Bharat- 100 Weeks Nasha Mukt Yuva Abhiyan'.
Activities included the Nasha Mukt Pledge, signature campaigns, thematic street plays, and youth-led discussions across 471 District MY Bharat Offices and partner organizations.

national_news.title: Union Sports Minister Leads 'Sundays on Cycle' in Nagoya for Asian Games 2026
bullets: Union Minister of Youth Affairs & Sports Mansukh Mandaviya led the 91st edition of ‘Sundays on Cycle’ at Meijo Park in Nagoya, Japan, on September 20, 2026.
The event aimed to rally the Indian diaspora to cheer for the Indian contingent of over 500 athletes participating in the Asian Games 2026.
The initiative promotes fitness under the Fit India Movement and is organized jointly by MYAS, Cycling Federation of India (CFI), Raahgiri Foundation, and MY Bharat.

national_news.title: Indian Air Force to Host First-Ever Three-Day Air Show in Varanasi
bullets: The Indian Air Force (IAF) is scheduled to hold a three-day aerial display over the Ganges in Varanasi on October 22, 23, and 25, 2026.
More than three dozen aircraft, including Rafale jets, Suryakiran aerobatic team, Tejas, Rudra, C-295, and Dakota, will perform aerial maneuvers.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi is expected to attend the final day as chief guest for the historic event covering the ghats from Namo Ghat to Assi Ghat.

national_news.title: Prime Minister Narendra Modi distributes over 51,000 appointment letters at the 20th Rozgar Mela
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi distributed over 51,000 appointment letters to newly recruited youth in various government organizations via video conferencing at the 20th Rozgar Mela.
The Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana has been launched with an outlay of around one lakh crore rupees to enable nearly two crore youth to enter the workforce for the first time.
India has signed Free Trade Agreements with nearly 40 countries in recent years to open new career and economic opportunities for the youth.

national_news.title: Nepal Finance Minister Calls for Renewed India-Nepal Economic Partnership
bullets: Nepalese Finance Minister Dr. Swarnim Wagle addressed an international seminar on 'Reimagining India-Nepal Relations in an Emerging Global Order' organized by RIS in New Delhi.
Key topics included cross-border connectivity, joint energy projects, disaster management investments, and early warning climate risk systems.
The Ministry of External Affairs emphasized expanding bilateral ambition across trade, power, education, and development cooperation.

national_news.title: Northeast Education Conclave 2026 Focuses on NEP 2020 Implementation
bullets: The two-day Northeast Education Conclave 2026 concluded at Chümoukedima in Nagaland, organized by the Government of Nagaland in collaboration with the Union Ministry of Education.
The conclave focused on effective implementation of NEP 2020, highlighting over Rs 21,000 crore invested in the Northeast education sector over the past decade.
Key targets include achieving a 50 percent Gross Enrolment Ratio in higher education by 2035 and transforming brain drain into brain circulation through enhanced skill development.

national_news.title: Indian Defence Service of Engineers Celebrates 77th Raising Day
bullets: Officers of the Indian Defence Service of Engineers (IDSE) cadre under the Military Engineer Services (MES), Ministry of Defence, celebrated their 77th Raising Day at Palam Air Force Station.
The central theme of the one-day conference held on September 17, 2026, was 'Ethics, Accountability and Excellence towards achieving the aim of Viksit Bharat @ 2047.'
Discussions emphasized transparency in public procurement, adoption of the Electronic Measurement Book, and the role of Integrity Pacts in infrastructure projects.

national_news.title: First Indian Navy Next Generation Missile Vessel Reaches Keel-Laying Milestone
bullets: Cochin Shipyard Limited laid the keel for the first Next Generation Missile Vessel (NGMV), designated BY 531, for the Indian Navy under a six-ship programme.
The Ministry of Defence had awarded the contract valued at approximately Rs 9,805 crore to Cochin Shipyard in March 2023.

The NGMVs are high-speed warships with a displacement of 1,437 tonnes, capable of reaching speeds of 35 knots, and equipped with indigenous surface-to-surface missile and anti-missile defense systems.

national_news.title: Nagpur's Indora–Dighori Flyover Inaugurated
bullets: Union Minister Nitin Gadkari and Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis inaugurated the Indora Chowk–Dighori Chowk Flyover in Nagpur.
The Rs 998-crore project developed by the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) is the city's largest and costliest flyover.
The 8.9-kilometre elevated corridor is built using Ultra High Performance Fibre Reinforced Concrete technology to decongest key east Nagpur corridors.

bihar_news.title: Chief Minister Samrat Chaudhory Highlights Bihar's Economic and Educational Growth
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Chaudhory inaugurated the 'Viksit Bihar: Foundation to Construction' brainstorming session and 'Lav-Kush Pratibha Samman Samaroh' in Patna.
Highlighted the state's budget growth, stating Bihar's 2024 budget reached Rs 3.17 lakh crore, surpassing Jharkhand's Rs 1.39 lakh crore budget.
Informed that academic sessions commenced in 211 degree colleges simultaneously on July 15, with 700 model schools and 75,000 teachers connected via the 'Vidyarthi Saathi' app.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Approves Rs 3,516 Crore Infrastructure Package for Gaya's Sacred Geography
bullets: The Bihar cabinet approved a massive Rs 3,516 crore infrastructure package on September 15, 2026, aimed at boosting the pilgrimage economy in Gaya.

Key projects include the Rs 2,520 crore redevelopment of the Vishnupad Temple precinct modeled after Varanasi's Kashi Vishwanath Corridor and a Rs 996.05 crore project to link the Son and Falgu rivers.
Between January and July 2026, Gaya and Bodh Gaya together recorded approximately 2.6 million domestic tourists and over 231,000 foreign visitors, far outpacing the state capital Patna.
The Vishnupad precinct development will be implemented by the Bihar State Road Development Corporation and will feature multi-level parking, elevated pathways, modern ghats, and dormitories.

bihar_news.title: Bihar CM Launches National Innovation Challenge and Shyama Prasad Mukherjee Car Rally
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary inaugurated the National Innovation Challenge under the Seva Sankalp Abhiyan and flagged off the Shyama Prasad Mukherjee Car Rally.
The state government set a target of establishing 10,000 industries in Bihar over the next five years, with land already allocated to around 1,000 industrial units.
The government launched initiatives such as the Vidyarthi Sathi app for competitive exam preparation and established 700 Saraswati Vidya Niketan model schools.
